systolic.label: Systolic Arterial Pressure
systolic.physiologicNote: Initial cephalad fluid shift elevates stroke volume; subsequent hypovolemia (~12% plasma reduction) stabilizes resting pressures.

diastolic.label: Diastolic Arterial Pressure
diastolic.physiologicNote: Systemic vascular resistance generally maintained or slightly decreased in microgravity.

heartRate.label: Resting Heart Rate
heartRate.physiologicNote: Resting heart rate in conditioned astronauts often stays lower in-flight unless hypovolemic stress or thermal load is present.

spo2.label: Pulse Oximetry (SpO2)
spo2.physiologicNote: Homogeneous alveolar ventilation in 0g preserves high hemoglobin saturation.

opticDisc.label: Peripapillary Retinal Thickness
opticDisc.confidence: Moderate (Longitudinal OCT fundus scans from 40+ long-duration flyers)
opticDisc.physiologicNote: Persistent cephalad venous pressure elevates optic nerve sheath diameter (ONSD) and can induce disc edema.

visualAcuity.label: Visual Acuity (LogMAR)
visualAcuity.physiologicNote: Posterior globe flattening causes a hyperopic shift (+0.50 to +1.50 diopters) in long-duration crew.

vorGain.label: Vestibular Ocular Reflex (VOR)
vorGain.confidence: High (Dynamic visual acuity and eye-tracking helmets)
vorGain.physiologicNote: Otolith-canal discordance dampens gaze stabilization during head turns until cerebellar reweighting occurs.

pco2.label: Cabin Ambient pCO2
pco2.confidence: High (ISS Environmental Control & Life Support System telemetry)
pco2.physiologicNote: Absence of natural thermal convection causes localized CO2 pooling around astronaut sleeping quarters if ventilation is impaired.

spineElongation.label: Axial Spine Elongation
spineElongation.physiologicNote: Intervertebral disc imbibition causes 2–5 cm stature lengthening and paraspinal flattening.

calfCircumference.label: Calf Muscle Circumference
calfCircumference.confidence: High (Pre/post-flight MRI & in-flight circumferential tape telemetry)
calfCircumference.physiologicNote: Fluid shift produces immediate bird-leg phenomenon (-1 to -2 cm), followed by slow slow-twitch soleus atrophy if unexercised.
